| Scheme | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiToken` | `http bearer` | An API token passed as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. |
| `ingestToken` | `http bearer` | An ingest credential, issued per cloud and passed as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. |
| `internalToken` | `http bearer` | The shared secret the components of this fixture call one another with. |
